# InsulinEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to Insulin.

## Scope note

Narrower than HealthEvent (and DiabetesEvent); a single insulin dose or administration event.

## Broader

- [DiabetesEvent](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
